summary: Code-quality cleanup of the machine-based post-processor pipeline that also changes two Machine property defaults (drill_cycles_to_translate now lists G81/G82/G83/G73, parameter_order now XYZABCUVWFSIJKTQRPDHL), makes the OpenSBP post reject bare T tool-prep commands, and deprecates Maneuver.FromGCode.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Processor.py get_common_property_schema: drill_cycles_to_translate default becomes Constants.EXPANDABLE_DRILL_CYCLES (G81 G82 G83 G73) and parameter_order default becomes Constants.PARAMETER_ORDER 'XYZABCUVWFSIJKTQRPDHL' (was 'XYZABCFSIJTQRPH'); help text for drill cycles lists the new set
Path/Post/Processor.py get_common_property_schema: Machine-scope defaults for 'Drill Cycles to Translate' and 'Generated Parameter Order for GCode' changed; the Machine editor shows these values

Path/Post/Processor.py: common property defaults changed (drill_cycles_to_translate, parameter_order); _convert_move now reads PARAMETER_ORDER from Constants; _convert_drill_cycle keys on Constants.EXPANDABLE_DRILL_CYCLES; export2 stage comments renamed (Stage 1 'Postable List', Stage 2 includes block insertion) which the 'The export2 pipeline' section may mirror
Path/Post/scripts/opensbp_post.py: 'T' added to the unsupported command list, so OpenSBP output no longer accepts the bare T early-tool-prep commands; probe-failure MSGBOX now names the job/operation
Processor.py and opensbp_post.py hunks swap ValueError/Exception for CAMValueError/CAMAttributeError and remove FIXMEs; no documented argument, hook or workflow changes

Constants.py adds EXPANDABLE_DRILL_CYCLES, GCODE_DRILL_COMMANDS, GCODE_BARE_T and PARAMETER_ORDER; Path/Base/Language.py deprecates Maneuver.FromGCode in favour of FromPath, but the page's headings do not cover Language.Maneuver or these constants
